text:
tara_recruiting: quick question about benefits while on an unpaid sabbatical 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-01 4c5. Specifically: 1) will employer 401k match stop? 2) can I make up missed employee deferrals after I return? 3) what happens to my HSA payroll contributions?

leah_benefits: hi @tara_recruiting :wave: TL;DR: match is based on wages paid. if there are no paychecks, there's generally no match for those pay periods. missed pre-tax deferrals cannot be backdated on payroll records, but the plan vendor sometimes accepts a one-time after-the-fact contribution if plan admin approves and IRS limits allow. HSA payroll contributions stop with unpaid payroll; you can contribute outside payroll to your HSA custodian.

oscar_payroll: adding details: payroll cutoff is two business days before pay. if you want a higher deferral before leave, update by that deadline. for post-return catch-ups, we need vendor approval and paperwork; it isn't automatic. loan repayments: set up ACH with the vendor if you won't have payroll withholding. missed loan payments can be taxable as a distribution.

forus-rep: Forus here 44b. We will accept trustee transfers and manual contribution files provided plan admin approves. For one-time contributions we need a signed form + remittance and confirmation it doesn't exceed annual limits. For loan ACH please complete the ACH authorization and send to transfers@forus.example.

tara_recruiting: thanks. if I get paid partially via short-term disability while on leave, does that count toward match?

leah_benefits: good question. paid wages (including STD or state disability paid through payroll) that are eligible compensation do count for match. if disability is paid outside payroll, it's less clear. we can confirm specifics after you tell me how payments will be processed.

oscar_payroll: pro tip: if someone's LOA overlaps a vendor migration (we're doing one in July), flag them in the LOA tracker so we can coordinate transfer + ACH setup.

leave-bot: Helpful link: https://benefits.redwood.example/leave-and-retirement (see sections "Leaves, Match, and Loan Repayments")

tara_recruiting: I'll DM my exact dates and any STD paperwork. I'd like to try for a one-time catch-up if possible 4b8. Thanks everyone!
